cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Analyst, Equity Investment Services role in Boston. The posting centers on using Python and SQL to build analytics, reporting workflows and ad hoc insights for Equity leadership. That is close to how I already work.

As Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental since August 2023, I run financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, cutting processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. By improving financial reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue. I also build the annual operating budget, monthly forecasts, budget-vs-actual variance analysis and KPI reports that ownership uses to make decisions.

At Northrop Grumman I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership. That taught me to be precise with data and to explain a finding clearly to people who need to act on it, which the posting stresses when it describes communicating with all levels of management.

My academic background supports the role. I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk. I use Excel, SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy) and Tableau, and I have worked with the Bloomberg Terminal. At FYND in Tokyo I also researched AI tools and presented adoption recommendations to the co-founders, so I am comfortable with the AI-enabled workflows the team is building.

I have about three years of experience, I am a US citizen, and I am available immediately. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can help the Equity organization scale its analytics.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
